title: Harrington's global-economy reason for secrecy

tellings.quote: That's the global economy. If you disrupt that by taking away the reason for people to live their lives, everything falls apart and governments of the world will not be able to control the populace.

plain: A former US Secretary of Energy named John S. Herrington is said to have explained UFO secrecy as a way to protect the global economy. A man named Brent Friedman relays what Herrington told him: that revealing the truth would take away people's reason for living their lives as they do, and then "everything falls apart and governments of the world will not be able to control the populace." It offers a reason, from a senior official, for why governments would keep such a secret.
